pages.text: Emissions can be cleaned using a special set of devices - "vacuum tubes", "packagers" and "respirators".$(br)They are divided into iron, gold and diamond tiers.

$(l)Note:$()$(br)To make all these tools work, you need to combine one of your tools with a $(l:ecology_inst/page02)filter item$() (leaves, wool, paper) on an anvil. Sometimes crafting requires 2 filter items. If the packager is filled to a certain percentage, you can refill it in a similar way.

pages.title: $(l)Usage$()
pages.text: To use this set, equip it as shown on the first page, look at an emission block and hold right mouse button to vacuum the area.
